theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.86%) and Industrials (+0.18%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.45%) and Communication Svcs (-1.34%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.31%, defensives -0.86%, and value/cyclicals -0.54% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.17%, Dow -0.18%, Nasdaq +0.39% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.50%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 4.08% to 14.81, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.44% to $4,415.90, crude oil was little changed at $95.47, and bitcoin gained 6.23% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
